description: Add a non-destructive photo editor accessible from the lightbox. Supports crop (with aspect ratio presets and rule-of-thirds overlay), adjustment sliders (exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, temp, saturation, vibrance, vignette), and preset filters (Punch, Warm, Cool, Matte, B&W, Film). Edits preview live via CSS filters in the browser. On save, the backend renders the final image using sharp (libvips) and stores the edit parameters locally. On commit, edited versions are uploaded to Immich as new assets and stacked with their originals.
designReference: design/design_handoff_photodesk/lightbox.jsx (Editor, Stage, Histogram), design/design_handoff_photodesk/components.jsx (adjCss, tempOverlay, vignetteOverlay, ADJ_ZERO, PRESETS), design/design_handoff_photodesk/README.md Section 4 (Editor).
principles: Non-destructive: original is always preserved. Edits save as new versions stacked over originals.
Live preview: all adjustments render in real-time via CSS filters before committing to server-side rendering.
CSS-to-sharp parity: the browser CSS preview must closely match the sharp-rendered output. Document any known divergences.
Humble scope: this is not Lightroom. Exposure/contrast/crop/presets cover 90% of phone photo fixes.
stories: ED-001: Editor panel UI — split layout (preview left, controls right 320px), crop/adjust tab toggle, preset pill row
ED-002: Adjustment sliders — 8 sliders grouped into Light/Color/Effects, -100 to 100 range (vignette 0-100), double-click label resets to 0
ED-003: Live CSS preview engine — port adjCss/tempOverlay/vignetteOverlay from components.jsx to vanilla JS, apply as filter + overlay divs on the Stage image
ED-004: Preset system — Original/Punch/Warm/Cool/Matte/B&W/Film, each sets an adjustment bundle, clicking applies instantly
ED-005: Crop UI — aspect ratio grid (Original/1:1/4:5/5:4/3:2/2:3/16:9), rule-of-thirds overlay, live aspect ratio change on the preview
ED-006: Decorative histogram — SVG, shifts with exposure, uses photo seed for deterministic shape (nice-to-have, can simplify)
ED-007: Backend sharp rendering — new POST /api/edits/render endpoint, accepts asset ID + adjustment params + crop, fetches original from Immich, renders via sharp, returns the processed image buffer
ED-008: Edit state persistence — new edits table in SQLite (session_id, asset_id, adjustments JSON, crop JSON, rendered_path, created_at). Save stores params + rendered file locally.
ED-009: Toast and badge integration — 'Saved as new version · original preserved' toast on save, EDITED badge on thumbnails in grid and filmstrip
ED-010: Commit integration — on commit with 'Upload edited versions' checked, upload each rendered file to Immich via POST /api/assets (multipart), then POST /api/stacks to stack edited over original
backendDependencies: sharp npm package for image processing (npm install sharp)
Immich asset upload endpoint: POST /api/assets (multipart form-data: assetData file, fileCreatedAt, fileModifiedAt)
Temporary storage for rendered files: ./tmp/ or configurable path, cleaned after upload
researchNeeded: sharp filter equivalents for CSS brightness/contrast/saturate — sharp uses different parameter semantics (e.g., sharp.modulate for brightness, sharp.linear for contrast)
Temperature simulation in sharp: no direct equivalent to CSS warm/cool soft-light blend. May need compositing with a tinted overlay.
Vignette in sharp: radial gradient composite. sharp.composite with a pre-generated vignette mask.
Crop in sharp: sharp.extract({ left, top, width, height }) after computing the crop rectangle from the aspect ratio and the original image dimensions.

HEIC handling: iPhone photos may be HEIC. sharp supports HEIC read (with libvips compiled with libheif). The thumbnail proxy already serves preview-sized JPEGs, but for editing we need the original. Immich GET /api/assets/:id/original returns the raw file.
